name: Nela Riehl - Après le § 8 - Am 15
title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination: employment and social priorities – annual report 2026
part_text: 8a. Calls on the Commission and the Member States, within the framework of the European Semester, to closely monitor the direct transposition of Directive (EU) 2024/28311a and developments in platform work, with a view to ensuring fair and transparent working conditions, legal certainty and a level playing field; calls, in particular, for enhanced transparency and accountability in remuneration-setting mechanisms, especially where algorithmic management systems determine pay, in order to improve clarity, predictability and proportionality in income-setting practices; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Directive (EU) 2024/2831 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 October 2024 on improving working conditions in platform work (OJ L, 2024/2831, 11.11.2024, ELI:[http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2024/2831/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2024/2831/oj)).
